# Prompt Execution Logs

All files in this directory are auto-generated by the **Prompt Execution Protocol**
defined at the top of `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

## Filename Format

```
YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS_<meaningful-slug>.md
```

## Status Values

| Value      | Meaning                           |
| ---------- | --------------------------------- |
| `OPEN`     | At least one `- [ ]` task remains |
| `COMPLETE` | All tasks marked `[x]`            |

## Do Not Edit Manually

Log files are maintained by the agent during task execution.
To replay an unfinished log, issue any prompt — the protocol will detect it automatically.
